senses.gloss:
ITA-1.8.2.23 sapakṣaḥ सपक्षः
Context in which a cause-and-effect relationship is affirmed
Figuratively, an accommodating context or environment.

ITA-8.3.9 sapiṇḍikaḥ सपिण्डिकः
Fritter-like preparation with sweet honey stuffing
A preparation similar to a fritter with sweet stuffing in which honey is additionally mixed and prepared in bolus form.

ITA-2.9.1.12 saptamamāsa-garbhaḥ सप्तममासगर्भः
Seventh month of pregnancy
This month is characterized by nourishment of all foetal elements; fatigue of the pregnant woman; complete foetal development; clear manifestation of all body parts and organs; full formation of body parts.
